sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor waives service of Rule on behalf of the respondents.
2. By way of this application, the applicant convict prays for being released on parole leave for the purpose of preferring appeal against order of conviction.

3. Jail remarks show that applicant had been convicted for offences punishable under Sections 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code amongst other offences as well as under the provisions of POCSO Act and sentenced to 20 years imprisonment.
The applicant has undergone incarceration for approximately 01 year and 9 months as of now.

4. Considering the reasons stated and having regard to the fact that the applicant at the time of the conviction was aged around 23 years and more R/SCR.A/4843/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/04/2023 particularly having regard to the nature of the offences for which the applicant has been convicted,

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: this Court is inclined to consider this application albeit with appropriate safeguards since the applicant would be released for the first time.

The applicant is directed to be released on parole leave for a period of 21 days from the date of actual release on executing personal bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) before the Jail authority and on usual terms and conditions as may be imposed by the Jail Authority.
The applicant shall mark his presence on the 7 th day and the 14th day of leave before Amletha Police Station.
The applicant convict to surrender before Jail Authority on completion of parole leave, without fail.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Registry is directed to communicate this order to the concerned Jail Authority by fax / email message forthwith.
